description: Open a QA session for the low-level tools (qa_snapshot, qa_act, flows); qa_test_this opens its own. projectRoot defaults to MCP roots > SWIPIUM_PROJECT_ROOT > CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR > a project-like cwd. Default budget: 30 min / 60 actions / 40 screenshots. fixtures declare preconditions; unmet ones report blocked, not failed.

responseMode.description: Output detail: compact (summary + URIs), normal (default, + JSON), verbose (all JSON, element objects).

sensitive.description: Refuse all screenshots, recordings, and on-screen evidence.

name: qa_start_session
title: Start a QA session
